description: Shows where one of the connected account’s own decodes (published or private, for example one just made in the drop box) would sit in the AIKIZI Brain: the public Brain pictures closest to it, up to 21, closest first, each with title, style, a small preview image, its aikizi.com/decode link and a link that opens it in the Brain. Reads only; never decodes and never spends. The person’s own decode stays private. Example: {"decode_id": "bc2be49a-ef44-417e-9015-4923febd46ae"}.

decode_id.description: A decode id from decode_image, add_image’s box or list_my_creations, or its aikizi.com/decode/<id> link

name: place_in_brain
title: Place my decode in the AIKIZI Brain
